name: The Necromancers
desc: Benson's novel of 1909 on spiritualism: a young man, Laurie Baxter, bereaved of the woman he loves, turns to a medium and falls under the control of the spirits, until a priest intervenes.
desc_pt: O romance de Benson (1909) sobre o espiritismo: um jovem, Laurie Baxter, enlutado pela mulher que ama, recorre a um médium e cai sob o domínio dos espíritos, até que um padre intervém.
edition: The Necromancers (London: Hutchinson, 1909), Project Gutenberg #14275, proofread.
srcnote: Chapters as printed; the numbered sections are kept as ## headings.
